title: Calibration Workmanship Warranty Goodwill Guideline: Amount of Calibration Goodwill
content:
**Guideline.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration goodwill on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty is the standard goodwill share of the calibration diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before, limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge and rounded to the cent. The standard goodwill share is 0.05, that is 5 per cent.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Charges taken | The calibration diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before the goodwill date, totalled |
| Calibration goodwill sum | The standard goodwill share, 5 per cent, applied to the charges so booked |
| Calibration goodwill | The calibration goodwill sum limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge, rounded to the cent |

The limit is the plan's goodwill authority per charge as the plan's rate card states it for the Calibration Workmanship Warranty; the goodwill is the lower of the calibration goodwill sum and that authority.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Charges booked less than one whole month before | Calibration goodwill sum | Hypothetical authority per charge | Calibration goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 83.92 | 5 per cent of USD 83.92 is USD 4.196 | USD 30.00 | USD 4.20 (USD 4.196 rounded to the cent) |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 50.00 | USD 30.00 | USD 30.00, limited to the authority |

Q. Is a calibration diagnostic charge booked two months before the goodwill date taken into the calibration goodwill?
A. No. Only charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before are taken.
